verdict.rationale: Runpod's pricing page lists a current-generation B300 at $8.99/hr, and a community user says H100s are easy to get on Runpod. Cheaper previous-generation choices are only implied: a community report mentions deploying on 4090s (now with low availability), and the docs note Community Cloud's competitive pricing. missing for 10: first-party GPU catalog naming H100/H200/B200, documented previous-generation datacenter options (e.g. A100) with lower pricing, evidence of reliable availability across tiers.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: B300 288 GB HBM3e 251 GB RAM 32 vCPUs $8.99/hr
even Colab Pro doesn't offer H100s, whereas you can get that pretty easily on Runpod.
Runpod used to have high availability of 4090 GPUs just about a month ago
Community Cloud: Connects individual compute providers to users through a vetted, secure peer-to-peer system, with competitive pricing options.
